description: This file defines a Python module for language code enumerations used in speech and text processing within the Pipecat project. It includes a comprehensive set of language constants following ISO 639 and BCP 47 standards, with compatibility code for Python versions before 3.11, and a function to resolve language enums to service-specific codes.

classes.name: StrEnum
classes.description: A string enumeration base class for Python versions earlier than 3.11, providing compatibility for enum string values.

methods.name: resolve_language
methods.description: Converts a Language enum to a service-specific language code, using a provided mapping and optionally extracting the base code.
